title: Sanitizer
summary: A Streamlit app that generates fully synthetic versions of Excel workbooks, preserving relational structure, statistical distributions, and foreign-key integrity while replacing text fields with Faker-generated values. It builds SDV Metadata objects and CAG constraints, then fits SDV's HMASynthesizer for multi-table relational data (falling back to GaussianCopulaSynthesizer per table) to produce the synthetic output.
evidence: sanitizer/synthesizer.py: 'synth = HMASynthesizer(metadata=metadata, verbose=True)'; imports from sdv.cag, sdv.metadata, sdv.multi_table, sdv.single_table
